HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   D. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   B. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.

3. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   B. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.
   D. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

5. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   C. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.
   C. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   D. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.
   C. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

12. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   B. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   B. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.

14. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.
   C. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Public Participation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Participation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Public Participation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Participation.
   D. Explain Public Participation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Linguistic groups in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Linguistic groups in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Linguistic groups in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Linguistic groups in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Linguistic groups in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Public Participation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Elections in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
